LanguageData.CC_PEv5_StirDone: The gravewardens of {FACTION} put down the colony's risen dead and buried {COUNT} of them beyond the wall, ringing the bell over each grave. They asked the colony to bury its dead from now on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_StirDonePromise: The gravewardens of {FACTION} put down the colony's risen dead and buried {COUNT} of them beyond the wall, ringing the bell over each grave. The Bell will remember the colony's promise to bury its dead.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_StirDoneFought: The gravewardens of {FACTION} put down the colony's risen dead and went home. They asked the colony to bury its dead from now on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_PromiseBroken: The colony's dead have risen again, after it promised the Bell to bury them. {FACTION} have heard of it, and think less of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_StirBury: When the shamblers are down, the gravewardens dig a grave for each beyond the wall, lay them in it and ring the bell over every grave.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_StirBuryBrief: The risen buried beyond the wall
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Promise: The colony promises {0} to bury its dead from now on. If its dead rise again within the year, the Bell will hear of it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_StirAway: The gravewardens of {0} stop fighting and leave.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Mourned: The mourners of {FACTION} stood an hour at their people's graves beyond the wall while the bell was rung, and went home. Their people think a little better of the colony for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_GravesGone: The graves they came to see are gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Mourn: The bell-keeper walks the mourners out to the graves beyond the wall, where they stand for an hour while the bell is rung.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_MournWith: The bell-keeper walks the mourners out to the graves beyond the wall, and {0} goes out to stand with them for the hour while the bell is rung.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Truce: {0} are at war with the colony. After the mourners have been, they may offer a truce by letter.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_PostRaised: {PAWN_nameDef} has set up the bell-post among the colony's graves and rung it once. The graves round it are a grave-garden now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_GardenDone: The sextons of {FACTION} have finished the grave-garden: {COUNT} flagstones laid between the graves, {ROSES} roses planted beside them, and the bell-post among them. Anyone who spends a while there finds the ground quiet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_PostDone: The sextons of {FACTION} have set up the bell-post among the colony's graves. Anyone who spends a while there finds the ground quiet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_GardenUnfinished: The sextons of {FACTION} had to leave before the bell-post was up. What they laid stays, but the graves are not a grave-garden.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_FullerRite: The funeral in the grave-garden is over, and the bell-post was rung at the end.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_NoGardenRoom: There is no room among the colony's graves for the work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Garden: Over three days, two sextons lay flagstones between the colony's graves, plant roses beside them and set up a bell-post, which becomes the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Post: This afternoon, the sextons set up a bell-post among the colony's graves, which becomes the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Quiet: While the bell-post stands, anyone resting in the grave-garden gets a good mood, and a funeral there is remembered as a fuller rite. With Anomaly, a body lying in its ground does not rise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_FallenMourners: Mourners of {THING} have come to stand at the row of graves beyond the wall, and their people think better of the colony for letting the Bell bury their dead.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_FieldStirs: {COUNT} of the dead still lying in the field of the fallen have got up again as shamblers. The Bell's people at the camp are calling to each other, and {X_nameDef} is shouting for everyone to get up.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Fallen: The bell-keepers of {0} camp for a few days, dig a row of graves beyond the wall and bury up to {1} of the dead lying on the colony's land, ringing the bell at each dusk.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_FallenBrief: The dead buried beyond the wall
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_ClaimGive: {0} walk out to the field and carry their dead away, one each.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_ClaimRefused: {0} take it badly. If they are at war with the Bell they may come against its camp, otherwise they take their dead anyway.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Bonded: {BEAST_nameDef} has learned {WHAT}, and is now bonded to {PAWN_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_BondTrained: {BEAST_nameDef} has learned {WHAT} with {PAWN_nameDef} beside it, but did not bond with {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_HandGone: The one meant to work with the animal is not here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Bond: {0} spends the afternoon putting {1} through every task it can learn, with {2} kept at its side, and leaves them bonded.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_BondLesson: {0} gets a lesson in handling animals.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_BondExpert: {0} gets a lesson in handling animals and the Trainer expertise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_BondWords: {0} gets a few pointers about handling animals.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_EggHatched: The Circuit's egg has hatched: {BEAST_nameDef} is here, and has bonded with {PAWN}, who looked after the egg the most.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_EggHatchedAlone: The Circuit's egg has hatched: {BEAST_nameDef} is here. {PAWN} looked after the egg the most, but it did not bond with anyone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_EggCold: The Circuit's {THING} got too cold and will not hatch now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_EggLost: The Circuit's {THING} is gone, and nothing hatched from it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_EggLookedOver: {TAMER} spent an hour with {BEAST_nameDef} and went away pleased with how it has grown. It learned a little more while {TAMER} was here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Egg: The egg is the colony's to keep warm until it hatches. The young will bond with whoever spends the most time near it, else with {0}, and the tamer will come back to see it grown.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_EggLook: {0} goes over to {1} and works with it for an hour, and it learns a little more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_RingWon: {PAWN_nameDef} won this afternoon's bout at the Circuit's ring against {PET}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_RingLost: {PAWN_nameDef} lost this afternoon's bout at the Circuit's ring against {PET}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_RingChampion: Before the tamers left, {X_nameDef} tied the Circuit's token on {A_nameDef}'s arm for winning {COUNT} bouts at their ring, more than anyone else of the colony. {X_pronoun} also gave {A_objective} a {THING} from the Circuit's hatchery, and the tamers will tell the region about it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_RingNoCompanion: None of the tamers' animals is up for a bout right now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_RingEnoughToday: Two of the colony have already challenged today.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Ring: The tamers of {0} camp by the colony for a few days with a bout every afternoon. The colony can send its hands to challenge from the camp's page.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_RingRisk: One bout in twenty-five, the animal's blow lands and leaves the challenger with a bruise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Challenge: {0} goes to the ring and takes on one of the tamers' animals in a friendly bout this afternoon.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_MendDone: The night crew of {FACTION} mended {COUNT} of the colony's damaged buildings by lamplight and left before morning.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_MendDoneGear: The night crew of {FACTION} mended {COUNT} of the colony's damaged buildings by lamplight and left before morning, taking {GEAR} pieces of the raiders' broken gear with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Mend: The crew works through the night by lamplight, mending the damage ({0} and more), and leaves before morning.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_BetterTaken: {PAWN_nameDef} handed {PAWN_possessive} {THING} over to {FIXER_nameDef}, who is taking it to the Wheel's cart for a day.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_BetterBack: {FIXER} brought {PAWN}'s {THING} back from the Wheel's cart, a grade better and fully mended.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_BetterByRunner: A runner of the Wheel brought {PAWN}'s {THING} back from the cart, a grade better and fully mended. It is by the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_OwnerGone: The owner of the piece is not here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_PieceGone: The {0} is no longer being worn or carried.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Better: {0} hands over the {1}, the fixer takes it to the Wheel's cart, and brings it back a day later at {2} quality and fully mended.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_WagonBuilt: The fixers of {FACTION} have finished the colony's {THING} by the gate. It is the colony's now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_WagonUnfinished: The fixers of {FACTION} had to leave before the vehicle was finished. What was set down for it is left by the gate for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_NoWagonRoom: There is no open ground by the gate big enough to build on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Wagon: The fixer sets the goods down by the gate and builds the {0} there over a day. Then it is the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_WagonBrief: A vehicle built at the gate
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_WagonLesson: {0} works beside the fixers through the day and learns from them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardQuarrel: {X_nameDef} of the Wheel's yard and {A_nameDef} argued over a price at the stall. The yard is a little less friendly now, and its mending will cost a bit more for the rest of the stay.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardHaggleBack: That is twice what it is worth.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardHaggleBack_2: I could buy a new one for that.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardStays: {X_nameDef} says the trade here is good, and the Wheel's yard will stay {COUNT} days longer than it meant to.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardMended: {X_nameDef} of the Wheel's yard has finished mending the colony's worn things, {COUNT} pieces in all.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardNoFixer: None of the yard's fixers is free right now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardNothingWorn: Nothing of the colony's is worn enough to need mending.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_YardNoScrap: The colony has no scrap to sell.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_Yard: The yard of {0} camps three days at the edge of the colony's land, with a scrap market (their trader), a mending tent and their pack animals.
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_YardBrief: A Wheel yard at the edge
LanguageData.CC_PEv5_Impact_YardMend: A fixer from the yard goes round the colony's {0} worn things and mends each back to whole.
